title: Melange: A Synthetic Visual Bias Benchmark for Multi-modal Large Language Models
title_zh: Melange：面向多模态大语言模型的合成视觉偏见基准

paragraphs.en: 提出Melange合成视觉偏见基准，评估23个多模态大模型发现视觉输入使公平性显著下降。 Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have seen broad adoption, but their biases are still far less examined than those of standard LLMs, creating possible social harms when deployed in real-world settings. Prior efforts to extend bias analyses from LLMs into the multi-modal space either cover only a few bias categories or do not ensure that the groups being compared are clearly addressed by visual cues in the images. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Melange, a wide-ranging synthetic visual benchmark covering seven categories for assessing social biases in MLLMs. It is grounded in the widely used language-only BBQ dataset (Bias Benchmark for Question Answering) from BigBench, carefully extending its constructed contexts via controlled generation of visual scenarios so the target attributes appear visually and clearly. To maximize reliability, our generated images pass through two stages of validation: automated screening using visual question answering (VQA) and subsequent manual inspection by human annotators. By systematically evaluating 23 open-source MLLMs across three matched evaluation settings---text-only, image-only, and image-with-context---Melange isolates the fairness effect of the input modality. Switching from text to vision reduces fairness by 0.291 on average, a gap that varies by model family rather than by scale alone. A perception control confirms that this gap is not an artifact of visual comprehension: models identify the depicted attributes at 90--95\% accuracy yet still fail to abstain. When models do commit to a biased answer, polarity-aware stereotype alignment shows they choose the human-stereotypical response roughly three-quarters of the time.
paragraphs.zh: 提出Melange合成视觉偏见基准，评估23个多模态大模型发现视觉输入使公平性显著下降。多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）已获得广泛应用，但其偏见受到的审视仍远少于标准大语言模型，这在现实场景部署时可能造成社会危害。 此前将偏见分析从大语言模型扩展到多模态领域的工作，要么仅覆盖少数偏见类别，要么无法确保所比较的群体在图像中被视觉线索明确指涉。 为克服这些局限，我们提出Melange，一个覆盖七个类别的广泛合成视觉基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型中的社会偏见。 该基准基于BigBench中广泛使用的纯语言数据集BBQ（问答偏见基准），通过受控生成视觉场景对其构建的语境进行细致扩展，使目标属性以视觉且清晰的方式呈现。 为最大化可靠性，我们生成的图像经过两阶段验证：先使用视觉问答（VQA）进行自动筛选，随后由人工标注员进行人工检查。 通过在三种匹配的评估设置下系统评估23个开源多模态大语言模型——纯文本、纯图像和图像加语境——Melange分离出输入模态对公平性的影响。 从文本切换到视觉使公平性平均下降0.291，这一差距因模型系列而异，而非仅取决于规模。 一项感知控制实验证实该差距并非视觉理解能力所致：模型以90%至95%的准确率识别所描绘的属性，却仍未能选择弃答。 当模型确实给出带偏见的答案时，具有极性感知的刻板印象对齐分析显示，它们约四分之三的情况下会选择符合人类刻板印象的回应。
